video.title: Mountain Weather Update 10/30, Meteorologist Chris Tomer

description: Remnant Vance moisture 10/30-10/31 (4-Corners only), then a larger storm system 11/1-11/2 with moderate to heavy mountain snow with bullseyes around the high Wasatch, Brian Head, AZ Snowbowl, and the CO San Juan range.  Heavy rain at lower elevations and some flooding.  Next storm system 11/6-11/7.
